objectives.label: Drive the wolves off the pasture at night

title: Wolves at the pasture
The flock is taken
summary: Wolves come down to the pasture of {settlement} at night and take the flock. {giver} wants them driven off.
offer: Three ewes gone this week and the dog torn open. The wolves come at night — wait for them by the pasture, {direction} of here, and see them off.
complete: A quiet night at last. The flock thanks you, and so do I.
